title: Rubber Duck Squeak
blurb: The squeak of a rubber duck, a sound with a surprisingly serious second career in software engineering. Rubber duck debugging means explaining your broken code out loud to a bath toy until you hear the flaw yourself, and it works, annoyingly often. Outside of that it is simply the perfect comedy squeak: light, silly, impossible to take seriously for even a moment. Good for cartoon edits, bath-time videos, and punctuating your own bad decisions.
origin: A squeeze recording of a classic rubber bath duck.
